title: GTA VI PC recompilation project shut down by Take-Two
description: Game modding communities are racing to get Grand Theft Auto VI running on PC, but one big effort has been taken down by Take-Two today. Leonida, a fan project by 15-year-old "NotRexed," has vanished after a DMCA takedown notice from GTA VI publisher Take-Two. Leonida was designed to translate a leaked GTA VI Xbox build […]
